name: Grady Reiff
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Houston, Texas
about: Attorney Grady Reiff is an associate with the Fullenweider Wilhite law firm, which has law offices in Houston and Austin, Texas. Focusing solely on family law, Mr. Reiff assists and guides clients throughout Texas with their legal needs involving divorce, child custody and support, modifications and enforcements, property division, pre- and post-nuptial agreements, and all other types of domestic relations issues.

In addition, Mr. Reiff has extensive experience handling gestational and fertility matters as well as donor agreements, adoptions and the termination of parental rights. Certified as a mediator from the Blakely Advocacy Institute at the University of Houston Law Center, Mr. Reiff helps his clients resolve their conflicts and reach agreements in the most amicable and cost-effective manner possible; however, he is also a tenacious and effective trial attorney who will not hesitate to take his clients' matters to court when necessary.

A 2005 graduate of the University of Texas, Mr. Reiff attended the University of Houston Law Center, where he obtained his Juris Doctor in 2010. Licensed to practice in Texas since that time, Mr. Reiff has earned consistent recognition from his peers as being among the top family law attorneys in the state.

Throughout his career, Mr. Reiff has also maintained active involvement in his legal community, and he is a member of the Houston Bar Association's Family Law Section. He also served as co-chairman of the Houston Bar Association's Golf Tournament Committee, and he is a member of the Burta Rhoads Raborn Family Law American Inn of Court and the State Bar of Texas. Furthermore, Mr. Reiff has conducted lectures and seminars regarding various family law topics across his region.
honors: Texas Rising Star, Texas Super Lawyers Publication, 2017 & 2018
